description: This file is a command-line installer script for the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It defines a CLI class 'CliInstall' with methods to facilitate installing OpenCart, setting up database schemas, and configuring necessary files. It also includes validation, error handling, and usage instructions.

classes.name: Install\CliInstall
classes.description: A CLI controller class responsible for executing the OpenCart installation process via command line. It handles argument parsing, validation, database setup, and configuration file writing.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Entry point for the CLI installer; processes command-line arguments to invoke install or usage methods.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Performs the installation process: validates environment, sets up database schema and data, writes configuration files.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Provides usage instructions and sample command line invocation for the installer.
